title: Outliner Management
description: Organise actors into folders and edit properties via multi‑select.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Keep your level tidy and edit multiple actors at once.

1. Place 5 Static Mesh actors (different shapes) in your level.
2. In the **World Outliner**, create a new folder called `Shapes`. Drag all 5 actors into that folder.
3. Rename the actors meaningfully (e.g., `Cube_Red`, `Sphere_Blue`).
4. Select all 5 actors at once (Ctrl+click in Outliner).
5. In the **Details Panel**, find the **Transform → Location** property and set **Z** to `100`. All shapes should jump up.
6. Now parent one sphere to the cube: drag the sphere onto the cube in the Outliner. Notice the hierarchy.
7. Move the cube in the viewport – the sphere should follow.
hints: Use the folder icon in the World Outliner toolbar to create folders quickly.
Multi‑select only shows properties common to all selected actors. If you don't see Location, check you selected the same type.
expectedOutput: A neat Outliner with a folder, parent‑child hierarchy, and all shapes elevated to Z=100.
